findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a Forge task or fix changes only the Python API or only the web app. Forge commits an item record under `.factory/` when it creates the branch (`src/forge/task.py:264-283` and `src/forge/repo.py:1117-1127`). That record is included in the diff, so this condition returns `null` and `scripts/test.mjs:59` runs the full `pnpm test`, including both API and web checks. The log also reports `Affected parts: all`. The new proof test edits files immediately after init without starting a task or fix, so it passes without exercising the normal pull request. This misses the owner-approved item: “A change to a client app runs lint, typecheck and tests only for the parts it touches, once, in the pull request check, and the log names those parts.”

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a developer writes a new API or web test and runs the documented `node scripts/test.mjs HEAD` before staging it. `git diff` omits untracked files, so the selector returns an empty list; `scripts/test.mjs:11-15` reports `Affected parts: none` and runs no checks, even if the new test fails. A new untracked file in a second part is likewise omitted when tracked changes select only the first part.
Adds work: include untracked paths in selection; F 3 x H 2 = 6; 2 x C = 4.
